verdict.rationale: GlitchTip has a CLI (glitchtip-cli) usable in scripts/CI for uploading source maps and creating releases, and its Sentry-compatible SDKs can be integrated into automated pipelines, suggesting some headless/CI usability. However there's no explicit documentation of headless server operation, CI pipeline examples, or automation-focused guidance beyond source map upload. missing for 10: explicit CI/headless usage examples, documented automation workflows, independent confirmation of CLI use in CI pipelines.
